title: Soda OS Goal Verification Contract Schema
description: Formal verification goal contract schema and profile extension framework uniting universal invariants, proof levels, and modular verification profiles.

schema_version.description: Schema version of the goal verification contract (e.g. 3 for Goal Contract v3)

invariants.description: List of machine-verifiable domain, algebraic, or behavioral invariants

id.description: Unique identifier for this invariant within the goal

statement.description: Unambiguous formal or behavioral statement of the invariant

kind.description: Class or category of invariant (e.g. conservation, monotonicity, idempotency, boundedness, termination, reachability)

formal_specification.description: Optional mathematical, TLA+, or code specification of the invariant

verification_command.description: Executable shell command or test script that verifies this invariant

passed.description: Indicates whether the invariant verification passed

exit_code.description: Exit code of the invariant verification command (must be 0 on pass)

proof_level.description: Epistemic proof level: L0 (informal), L1 (formal proof), L2 (executable property invariant), L3 (statistical evidence), L4 (production telemetry)

profiles.description: Active verification profiles, specified either as an array of profile identifiers or as a configuration mapping of profile names to profile definitions

profile_configs.description: Optional explicit mapping of active profile names to their respective configurations when profiles is specified as an array

fail_closed.description: Fail-closed enforcement flag: when true, any verification failure, ambiguous state, or missing proof blocks promotion and receipt issuance

mathematical_proven_governance.description: Formal mathematical verification and invariant governance across the 6 operational domains
Configuration across the 6 operational domains of mathematical proven governance

property_invariant.description: Property invariant profile: generative property-based testing and algebraic invariant verification

generators.description: List of generator functions or strategies producing test input domains

iterations.description: Number of generative fuzzing iterations (must be >= 10,000)

laws.description: Algebraic laws asserted (e.g. conservation, monotonicity, idempotency)

shrinking.description: Whether counterexample shrinking is enabled on assertion failure

stateful_model.description: Stateful model profile: state machine model checking and lockstep transition equivalence

model_ref.description: Reference or path to the authoritative reference state machine model

commands.description: Discrete state transition actions or command sequences exercised

lockstep.description: Whether system state is verified in lockstep against reference model after every command

trace_invariants.description: Invariants that must hold across all execution traces

adversarial_boundary.description: Adversarial boundary profile: boundary conditions, extremal values, and malicious payloads

extremes.description: Boundary values evaluated (e.g. MAX_INT, MIN_INT, NaN, empty buffers, Unicode overflows)

types.description: Data types subjected to adversarial testing

zero_tolerance.description: Zero tolerance flag: any unhandled exception or unparsed payload fails verification

payload_vectors.description: Concrete adversarial or fuzzing payload vectors

mutation_testing.description: Mutation testing profile: synthetic defect injection and test oracle strength verification

mutation_operators.description: Syntactic mutation operators applied (e.g. AOR, ROR, COR, LCR, statement deletion)

kill_threshold.description: Minimum percentage or fraction of mutants that must be killed by the test suite (>= 85% or >= 0.85)

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds allocated per mutant test run

epistemic_classification.description: Epistemic classification profile: verification claims, explicit assumptions, and abstraction boundaries

claimed_level.description: Epistemic verification level claimed for this goal

assumptions.description: Axiomatic assumptions or environmental preconditions required for the claim

abstraction_disclosures.description: Explicit disclosures of simplified models, hardware idealizations, or unmodeled noise

counterexample.description: Counterexample profile: deterministic minimizer, PRNG seed reproduction, and structured trace capture

minimizer_enabled.description: Whether automated delta-debugging or shrinking is applied to counterexamples

seed.description: PRNG seed used to deterministically reproduce the test run or counterexample

schema_format.description: Data serialization format for persisted counterexample artifacts (e.g. json, trace, yaml)

concurrency_schedule.description: Concurrency schedule profile: race condition detection, thread interleavings, and distributed fencing

interleavings.description: Number of distinct thread/task execution schedules explored

races_tested.description: Names of concurrent race conditions or interleaving scenarios evaluated

fencing_token.description: Whether monotonic fencing tokens are asserted to prevent stale distributed writes
